text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! New Year's in Japan is<n>awful fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've had me some of those New<n>Year's dishes...
Freshly pounded<n>mochi, mochi soup—the works! It
was<n>all delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean I'm done<n>whoopin' it up. I
wanna do more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer! Know any other fun<n>things I could do?
choice_data_list: You could make a New Year's resolution.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, good idea! Grass was just sayin'<n>that too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know I wanna be the next<n>Umamusume of
the Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do, Trainer?<n>Become a
millionaire?
choice_data_list: I want to help you achieve your dream.
I want to help you achieve your dream.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're tellin' me we can<n>make both our
dreams come true at<n>the same time?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What can I say—our hearts are<n>beatin' as one!
Okay, let's work<n>together to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With our resolutions decided, next is<n>to figure out
the steps to get there...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well... If I had to get specific...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but thinkin' ain't my strong<n>suit! You're
gonna have to take this<n>one, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting to be thrown in<n>the deep end. If
we're going to make<n>Taiki Shuttle the next
Umamusume of<n>the Year...
choice_data_list: Let's work on increasing your speed.

Let's make sure you rest when you're supposed
to.
Let's work on increasing your arsenal.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Increasin' my speed? Oh, I know a<n>thing or two
about that! Call it my<n>specialty!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... I dunno what I<n>would've done if
you'd said<n>studying.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
N-not that I'm bad at studyin' or<n>nothin', mind you!
Honest!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Vaguely worried about just how poor<n>she must be
at studying, I talk her<n>through my ideas for brushing
up her<n>speed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer, just how much do ya<n>know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was plannin' on rounding up all my<n>friends for
some non-stop partyin'<n>this New Year's break...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But all right... I'll get some rest.<n>That's what I gotta
do to become<n>Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...But do ya think I could throw one<n>teensy little
party? Just for a single<n>day?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting anything to impact our<n>training, I warn
her to keep her<n>partying within reason.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Arsenal? Ya mean weapons?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So it's a quick draw ya want! Bang,<n>bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can also throw a mean lasso! Not to<n>mention...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I clarify that I'm not talking about<n>actual weapons,
but rather the<n>importance of improving her skills.
